name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.SplitRank.output_span_test
title: Exact output test on any pair of spanning row families
statement: For any GF(2) dot-product factorization, there exists a nonzero output on a pair of assignments iff there exists a nonzero pairing in any two replacement families spanning exactly the row spaces of the factors. Both families can in particular be replaced by row bases.
